title: Kafka consumer vs Kafka Streams vs Flink
description: Three ways to process a partitioned log. Watermarks, idle partitions, and sink idempotency decide correctness.

cells.workload: Pull records, process, commit offsets. Dual owner: coordinator + assignment.
cells.consistency: Offset commit is not the sink commit. Read-your-write only inside the processing you named.
cells.latency: Poll interval + processing. Rebalance pauses partitions.
cells.scaling: Partitions cap parallelism. Hot keys stay hot.
cells.failure: Rebalance, poison pill, lag. Replay from offset is the recovery, with duplicates unless idempotent.
cells.costOps: Consumer lag dashboards, DLQ, rebalance storms.
cells.whenNot: Exactly-once money without a sink uniqueness boundary. Offset != ledger.

cells.workload: Partitioned stream/table, changelog, state stores colocated with tasks.
cells.consistency: Changelog restore is derived from the log. Stream-time is max observed, not wall clock.
cells.latency: Local state is fast; restore after rebalance is the tail.
cells.scaling: Input partitions. Standby tasks trade disk for restore time.
cells.failure: Task migration restores from changelog. Idle partitions stall stream-time unless max.task.idle.ms is named.
cells.costOps: State store disk, changelog topics, restore SLOs.
cells.whenNot: Event-time windows that require min watermark across idle sources — that is the Flink story.

cells.workload: Event-time windows, watermarks, checkpoints to durable storage.
cells.consistency: Checkpoint barrier alignment. Min watermark; withIdleness needed for idle sources.
cells.latency: Checkpoint interval vs end-to-end. Two-phase commit sinks have a cost.
cells.scaling: Keyed parallelism independent of Kafka partitions if you reshuffle — and then you pay network.
cells.failure: Restore from checkpoint. Unaligned checkpoints and unacked sinks are UNKNOWN.
cells.costOps: JobManager/TaskManager, checkpoint storage, watermark delay as a product SLO.
cells.whenNot: A thin consumer would have been enough, or TokenX settlement inside a window operator.

assumptions: Produce durability is a separate matrix: RF, acks, minISR.
At-least-once to the sink unless the sink is idempotent on a named key.
Flink min watermark + withIdleness vs Kafka Streams max stream-time + max.task.idle.ms are not interchangeable slogans.
